calibration.example: Legible repair intake with clear labels, familiar layout, and misplaced focus after an invalid number
calibration.reason: Clear labels support the task, but the familiar layout is not especially distinctive and misplaced focus impairs error recovery.

primary_action.observed: The print changed to an enlarged detail with keyed explanations; the button became Return to the print and retained visible focus.

A-1440.edge_observation: Enter returned to the full print. Read the inscriptions retained a visible gold focus outline. Captures: A-1440-before, A-1440-after, A-1440-edge.
A-1440.fact_check: The boxed vertical inscription is the title cartouche; the separate vertical marks to its left are the signature. The A and B keys match those positions to the displayed translations: Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji and Under the Wave off Kanagawa for the cartouche, and Hokusai working under the name Iitsu for the signature. The added keys sit on the artwork's background, though they do not visibly cover the inscription characters. The locator outline also overlays the miniature print. Translation accuracy was not independently verified from a source during this review.
A-1440.strength: The enlarged marks and keyed explanations make the two inscriptions easy to distinguish.
A-1440.weakness: The eye must travel across a wide gap between detail and explanation. The locator is small and its outlined region is difficult to inspect.
A-1440.repair: Move the explanation closer to the detail and enlarge the locator or make its boundary more legible.

primary_action.observed: The detail and keyed translations appeared together before scrolling, with visible focus on Return to the print.

A-390.edge_observation: Enter returned to the print and the action retained a visible gold focus outline. Captures: A-390-before, A-390-after, A-390-edge.
A-390.fact_check: The boxed marks match the title-cartouche explanation and the separate marks on the left match the signature explanation. A and B keys aid the match but overlay background areas of the artwork; the locator outline overlays the miniature. The displayed translations were not independently verified.
A-390.strength: The entire detail, explanations and locator fit in the initial viewport.
A-390.weakness: The narrow two-column layout makes both the inscription marks and locator small, and the text wraps into many short lines, increasing scan burden.
A-390.repair: Give the detail and locator more width and use a mobile layout that preserves readable text without excessive wrapping.

primary_action.observed: The print changed to an unlabelled enlarged detail and adjacent explanations; Return to the print retained visible focus.

B-1440.edge_observation: Enter returned to the print with a visible gold focus outline on Read the inscriptions. Captures: B-1440-before, B-1440-after, B-1440-edge.
B-1440.fact_check: The rectangle identifies the cartouche, and the separate marks to its left match the signature description. The displayed translations identify the series and print title and Hokusai's Iitsu name. No added labels cover the enlarged artwork, but the locator outline overlays the miniature print. Translation accuracy was not independently verified.
B-1440.strength: The enlarged artwork remains unobstructed and the relative positions support the match.
B-1440.weakness: Matching text to marks requires more inference and a long horizontal scan. The small locator makes its outlined area hard to read.
B-1440.repair: Place concise spatial cues beside the detail without covering the marks, and enlarge the locator.

primary_action.observed: The unlabelled detail, translations and locator appeared before scrolling, with visible focus on Return to the print.

B-390.edge_observation: Enter returned to the print and left visible focus on Read the inscriptions. Captures: B-390-before, B-390-after, B-390-edge.
B-390.fact_check: The boxed vertical marks correspond to the cartouche; the separate column to the left corresponds to the signature, as described in the text. The enlarged detail has no added labels, while the locator outline covers a small area of the miniature. The displayed translations were not independently verified.
B-390.strength: The detail and explanations remain visible together without an overlay on the enlarged image.
B-390.weakness: Small marks, a small locator and short wrapped text lines increase scan burden; the reader must infer the mapping without keys.
B-390.repair: Increase the detail and locator size and add unobtrusive spatial cues outside the image.

preference.reason: Both complete the keyboard flow and preserve visible focus. A's keys make the relationship between the two inscriptions and their explanations quicker to scan, especially on mobile. Their placement covers background in the artwork, so moving the cues outside the image would improve it.
